findings.title: Document cleanup left source inventory, build and audit contracts inconsistent
findings.scope_note: The entry-audit fixture proves contract incompatibility, not a Kodi runtime failure or cryptographic failure of the release.

findings.title: CE2021-only cleaner accepts older trusted generations and records a fixed, false original_sequence

Input has required profile/channel and matching entry-embedded payload
Operator supplies an earlier generation at the expected legacy paths

evidence_gaps.title: Current GitHub source is not the reported locally tested CE2021 source
